decks.expectation: Mardu aggro deck that builds a threatening combat board and exploits Isshin to double attack-trigger value, especially token generation and combat payoffs.
Rakdos value deck that repeatedly plays cards from exile to generate Treasures, then converts those extra resources and non-hand casts into damage and card advantage.
Jund creature deck that blitzes expensive creatures for immediate ETB/combat/death value, draws from their deaths, and recycles threats through the graveyard.
Sultai graveyard deck that self-mills permanents and uses Muldrotha to repeatedly replay them, generating resilient recursive value with reanimation/combo upside.
Selesnya enchantress deck that chains enchantments through Sythis for cards and life, using enchantment-based ramp and scaling payoffs to build toward a dominant board.
Mono-white Angel tribal deck that uses Giada as early acceleration and counter scaling, then curves into increasingly large evasive Angels backed by lifegain and protection.
Dimir Zombie deck that generates and recycles Zombie bodies, sacrifices them for value, and leverages Wilhelt’s replacement tokens alongside recursion and tribal payoffs.
